verdict.rationale: Agent identity verification is a fair question for an agentic-commerce payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers credential tokenization, ACP/UCP checkout orchestration, catalog feeds and fraud screening. Nothing shows agents presenting registered profiles, cryptographic signatures or trust tiers that let merchants tell trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots. Agent platforms integrating with Adyen and tokens bound to sessions do not amount to merchant-visible agent identity.
